messages:
olga: Opened PR to update catalog model-cards with migration notes + small examples for long context, quant fallback, and embedding shards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589
hank: Nice. Please add a minimal curl long-context example and call out that sequence_length is advisory in docs.
olga: added this curl example:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"nebula3b","input":"<long transcript>","max_tokens":256}'
```
ravi: also include a short python SDK snippet showing explicit model_variant for quantized fallback so customers don't rely solely on model_alias.
olga: added python snippet:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='nebula3b', model_variant='q4_1', input='hi')
print(resp.text)
```
hank: embedding sharding note: warn about changing shard_count mid-index and include a brief pseudo-example for client-side stitching.
olga: added a one-paragraph warning and a tiny pseudo-code comment for stitching. also fixed a broken anchor: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> /docs/catalog#available-models after doc-bot linkcheck flagged it.
doc-bot: Link check complete: fixed 1 anchor; preview build: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/589 (build 7832) :white_check_mark:
ravi: added small bench numbers from infra for reference (nebula3b p50 A100=22 tok/s, p95 T4=5 tok/s). included a callout that these are indicative.
hank: LGTM aside from one wording nit about "pin vs alias" in the compatibility section. I'll push a small copy edit.
olga: thanks — will merge after CI green. Ping me if you want snippets in another language. :thumbsup:
